PokeRogue Splicing Calculator

Preview what you get when you fuse two Pokémon in PokeRogue: the fused name, typing, ability and stats at your level, nature, IVs and held items. It can also rank every Pokémon as a partner for your pick, and any build can be shared as a link.

  • 1,363 Pokémon and forms, from the game's own source
  • Unit and UI tests, run by CI on every push
  • Static site, no server, on GitHub Pages
  • TypeScript
  • Vitest
  • GitHub Actions

Connect 4 vs. AI

A playable Connect 4 where you (blue) face an AI opponent (red) that searches the game tree with minimax and alpha-beta pruning to pick its moves.
